description: The SessionStart command hook checks that git and the GitHub CLI are on PATH, and names each one that is not. The hooks module pins the repo status line under the prompt: commits behind, branches to prune, dependency pull requests and Dependabot alerts, then each kind of problem. It refreshes the line on a timer and after a git, gh or sync command. The check fetches, but never changes a branch, worktree, or working tree.

hooks.command: if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"systemMessage":"\\ngh: ⚠️ node not found on PATH"}\n'; exit 0; fi; node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook-io.ts" session-start; exit 0
